statement: Policy Plus is a Windows desktop editor for Group Policy administrative-template settings. It loads policy definition files into a searchable tree and reads or writes values in the live registry, user profiles or policy files. Administrators and power users use it, including on Windows Home, which lacks the built-in editor.

The program has no users or roles of its own; Windows decides access. It requests the highest rights the signed-in user has, so changing machine policy needs an administrator. It tests writability and marks sources unmodifiable, and takes folder ownership only when an administrator downloads definitions.

It runs on the user's own Windows machine as a single desktop program on .NET Framework 4.x, editing that machine's registry and policy files. It hosts no service; its only outside call is the optional definitions download from Microsoft. That it is limited to administrator desktops is our assumption.
